title: Mountainash Concept Graph
description: Internal concept dependency graph for the mountainash package documentation rebuild: foundations and ecosystem, package surface, expressions and namespaces, ternary logic, relations, execution targets, types and schemas, conformance, data contracts and validation, RelationDAG and pipelines, Python data ingress/egress, architecture, capabilities, backends, and extension/maintenance.
creator: Nathaniel Ramm

id_policy: Replacement graph (editorial brief: reuse none, confirmed 2026-10-30). IDs start at 301 so no ID from the retired 2.0 graph (IDs 1-200, baseline 00e99834) is reused with a different meaning. ibook graph reconcile against the retired graph reports all 200 enriched concepts as removed and 18 labels re-used under new IDs (302,305,313,324,336-339,344,361,366,400,406,409,411,452,498,499); this is the deliberate retirement, not an identity match: re-used labels are re-derived from current source and carry no prior enrichment. Gaps between ID blocks are intentional and are never renumbered.
